setOnClosure.semantics: cbite.SetOn is exclusive: every relay not listed here is OFF/un-actuated for the whole TM109 function.
setOnClosure.noPhaseSplitReason: No relay state has to change between the DFT-declared stages (VBAT static, register writes, VAC2 ramp). A single standing closure set therefore serves the whole function, and the set is conflict-free (no shared relay between groups).
setOnClosure.implementationNote: All three relays must be actuated in ONE SetOn call - cbite.SetOn(K13_VBAT_Cap, K19_VAC2, K65_nQON_PU, -1). Splitting them over two consecutive SetOn calls releases the first group because SetOn is exclusive.

conflicts.resolution: RESOLVED. The DFT Check value INT is the logical check label of this item, not a statement that the DTEST0 output is physically presented on the INT/PA0 contact: the CSV check name, the project meta ('check int pin toggle') and the resolved monitorIntent ('DTEST0/nQON logic toggle') describe the same logical check, while INT, PA0 and nQON are three separate DUT Kelvin pins (Component-Statistic.txt line 61) and the current-project TestIO definition presents the digital test function DTEST0 on the nQON pad (project/DALI/_archive/_dump_TestIO.txt line 2). Since the binding register delta routes a2d_vac2_prst onto the DTEST0 output (registerDelta order 2, DMUX_SEL=21 = a2d_vac2_prst), the toggle can only be observed on nQON. openItems.topic: Relay contact current rating for the selected channels
openItems.description: The frozen canonical schematic IR publishes an open question that no relay contact current rating exists in this workspace. TM109 drives only a static 3 V rail, a swept VAC2 rail with a 100 uA/1 mA order compliance and one logic observation, all far below any plausible contact rating, so the gap does not affect this allocation.

The selected source tables are declared per site index (SITE_1 = slots S3/S5) and K13/K21 are _S1S2 instances. Simultaneous multi-site execution for a single TM function is not modelled by the frozen inputs; the contract allocates site-1 resources only.

usableBoundaries: VBAT: source table VBAT_PD3_FXVI (FXVIe_PLUS, SITE_1 port S3) channel 5, force S3_FXVIe_PLUS_FH5 / sense S3_FXVIe_PLUS_SH5, route actuations 0 (K8 stays un-actuated), rail value governed at 3.0 V; K13_VBAT_Cap closed.

VAC2: source table VAC123_AMUX_ACM (ACM200, SITE_1 port S5) channel 0, force S5_ACM200_FH0 / sense S5_ACM200_SH0, route actuation K19 only (K18/K20 un-actuated), return leg through AGND_F; K21_VAC_Cap must stay open (ramp exemption); VAC2 is the swept pin and the measured quantity.

nQON (DFT check label INT): source table NQON_HG1_ACM (ACM200, SITE_1 port S5) channel index 9, observation terminals S5_ACM200_FH9 / S5_ACM200_SH9, route actuations 0 (K64 stays un-actuated: its NC contact selects nQON_F_S1 / nQON_S_S1, while its ON position would select HG1), pull-up closed via K65_nQON_PU onto the fixed-5 V R_nQON_PU_S1; observation mode, trigger, sampling, capture level and limits are yours.
Register delta: 0x56 = 0x15 (DMUX_EN = 1) and 0x57 = 0x08 (DMUX_SEL = 21); entertestmode() precedes them. Values and sources must not be rewritten.

SetOn closure for the whole function is exactly {K13, K19, K65} in ONE call (cbite.SetOn(K13_VBAT_Cap, K19_VAC2, K65_nQON_PU, -1)); every other relay is un-actuated, including K64, K62, K66, K101, K102, K103 and K128.
